critical_code_review_comments: ReportShareControls.jsx (275 lines) is a clean, single-responsibility, reusable component with proper data-testid coverage and locked-section UX (disabled checkbox + Lock icon).

clean_excluded() applies sorted+deterministic normalization (great for JWT snapshot equality) and safety-locked keys are stripped at BOTH the visibility PATCH and share-link path — defense in depth verified end-to-end (posted pathway/texas_resources → stripped on server).

Public shared endpoints (/api/mediation/shared/{token}, /api/safety-assessment/shared/{token}, /api/neurodivergent/report/shared/{token}) correctly do NOT require Authorization header (verified: called with anonymous requests.Session).

Suggestion (non-blocking): the visibility PATCH for SN report is keyed on user_id only (no report_id) — implicitly assumes one live report per user (which is enforced elsewhere via delete_many). Fine today, but worth revisiting if history is ever surfaced.
Minor: fpdf2 emits DeprecationWarnings (dest='S', split_only=, ln=1) across sn_report_pdf.py + safety_assessment_pdf.py + pdf_service.py. Not a bug; upgrade path only.
